dc to vc, 2026-11-26 14:54Z by date -u: both measures are from Intent's copied-back kovacs leg records (tmp/release/legs/kovacs in Intent's checkout). Wall time is each GATES seal's start to end. Warm or cold is the rust gate's own line: "building in the target kept" or "building in a new target". Nothing was run. 1. Wall time, every passed leg on record: - COLD: 4d999b897e1e 7m16s (11-12), c64a42e29fb9 7m04s (11-13), 484ea426eeb6 7m17s (11-15), 10141745e531 7m39s (11-21, cache at 4 KiB), 029297deee27 66m17s (11-24, emptied), 8475de82526a 7m58s (11-24, emptied). - WARM: 7282d3bfcc66 6m32s, eebd6af5d6d3 6m17s, 83dce9b27ad5 6m39s, 0d8c7a306099 7m41s, 461e39ba145d 102m36s, 940c9535acf7 6m46s, 1cc654e5a36e 7m03s, 3475b6e945f8 7m05s, fabbffd8cb9e 7m32s, 68484d35b8b0 7m21s, 0eb2295119a0 7m26s, 0bab786dc32d 7m23s. - Read: without the two long legs, cold is 7m04s to 7m58s (median 7m17s) and warm is 6m17s to 7m41s (median 7m05s). Against the warm legs of the same days, a cold leg costs 30 to 55 s. The two long legs are one cold and one warm, so the cache does not explain them. No devbin leg overlapped either, and the logs carry no phase times to say which part was slow. 2. Does a leg at one commit warm the next? Partly, and only for the rust gate. - The runner hands every run of a project one directory, ~/work/

-leg.cache, whatever the sha (lib/release.legs:260, :335). - Intent keeps ONE cargo target there for its rust gate, rust-target (Intent's bin/.devbin/cut/gate:170-183). Each run moves it into that run's new private worktree and back (:212-216; gate_rust_cleanup at :193). Its comment (:166-167): a run reuses the dependencies the last one compiled, and only the workspace's own crates compile again. The target is emptied when rustc's version changes (:174-178). - Not kept: `build all`'s release build. It builds in the leg worktree's own target, new for each sha (lib/release.legs:257, :269). Every leg on record compiled the same 287 crates in 2m06s to 2m48s (cargo's Finished line), warm or cold. For your decision: a leg at Intent's main now would save hv's cut about 30 to 55 s of its kovacs leg. It costs a whole leg of about 7 to 8 minutes, a Desk slot and a notice to kovacs-sysadm. The cache is at 15G, over its bound, so that leg would itself start cold. Its other value is a rehearsal: it shows the kovacs leg green at main before hv's keystroke.
